effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 1 of 5 is on now: Team A (Izuku Midoriya and Ochaco Uraraka) as heroes against Team D (Katsuki Bakugo and Tenya Iida) as villains. Each slip shows its student's own team: A Midoriya/Uraraka, B Todoroki/Shoji, C Yaoyorozu/Mineta, D Bakugo/Iida, E Aoyama/Ashido, F Koda/Sato, G Jiro/Kaminari, H Tokoyami/Asui, I Ojiro/Hagakure, J Kirishima/Sero. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team J (Eijiro Kirishima and Hanta Sero) against Team E (Yuga Aoyama and Mina Ashido), with the player as the third member of Team J; Teams A, D are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 4 more rounds remain. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.
